trust_sql: CREATE TABLE runner_update_trust_states (channel TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(channel) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), update_root_digest TEXT NOT NULL, trusted_state_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(trusted_state_json)), created_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_unix_ms >= 0), updated_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_unix_ms >= created_unix_ms)) STRICT;
post_sql: CREATE TABLE runner_enrollment_replays (enrollment_token_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES enrollment_tokens(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, request_digest TEXT NOT NULL, runner_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES runners(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, pool_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runner_pools(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, certificate_chain_pem BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(certificate_chain_pem) BETWEEN 1 AND 262144), certificate_expires_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (certificate_expires_unix_ms > 0), authoritative_posture_digest TEXT NOT NULL, selected_protocol_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (selected_protocol_version > 0), created_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_unix_ms >= 0)) STRICT;
sql: CREATE TABLE runner_update_releases (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), component_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(component_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), release_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(release_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(channel) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), artifact_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(artifact_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 500), artifact_length INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (artifact_length >= 0), artifact_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(artifact_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), artifact_media_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(artifact_media_type) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), platform TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(platform) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), architecture TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(architecture) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), installed_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(installed_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), runner_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(runner_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), engine_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(engine_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), protocol_min INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (protocol_min > 0), protocol_max INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (protocol_max >= protocol_min), package_format TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(package_format) BETWEEN 1 AND 100), component_profile_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(component_profile_json)), component_profile_digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(component_profile_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), update_root_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(update_root_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), targets_metadata_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(targets_metadata_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), snapshot_metadata_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(snapshot_metadata_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), timestamp_metadata_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(timestamp_metadata_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), created_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_unix_ms >= 0), revoked_unix_ms INTEGER CHECK (revoked_unix_ms IS NULL OR revoked_unix_ms >= created_unix_ms)) STRICT; CREATE TABLE runner_pool_update_policies (pool_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runner_pools(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0), enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (enabled IN (0,1)), release_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runner_update_releases(id), runtime_compatibility_digest TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL, provider_template_id TEXT NOT NULL, runner_template_digest TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL, maintenance_window_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(maintenance_window_json)), rings_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(rings_json)), minimum_healthy INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (minimum_healthy >= 0), maximum_surge INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (maximum_surge >= 0), maximum_unavailable INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (maximum_unavailable >= 0), failure_threshold INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (failure_threshold > 0), required_attestation_grade TEXT NOT NULL, protocol_min INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (protocol_min > 0), protocol_max INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (protocol_max >= protocol_min), paused INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (paused IN (0,1)), created_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_unix_ms >= 0), PRIMARY KEY(pool_id,version)) STRICT; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runner_pool_update_policy_enabled ON runner_pool_update_policies(pool_id) WHERE enabled=1; CREATE TABLE runner_slots (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), pool_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runner_pools(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, updater_identity_digest TEXT NOT NULL, active_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (active_generation >= 0), active_runner_id TEXT REFERENCES runners(id), created_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_unix_ms >= 0), updated_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_unix_ms >= created_unix_ms)) STRICT; CREATE TABLE runner_replacements (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), pool_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runner_pools(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('autoscaled','fixed-host')), source_runner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runners(id), source_posture_digest TEXT NOT NULL, target_runner_id TEXT REFERENCES runners(id), target_posture_digest TEXT, runner_slot_id TEXT REFERENCES runner_slots(id), source_fleet_request_id TEXT REFERENCES runner_fleet_requests(id), target_fleet_request_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES runner_fleet_requests(id), generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0), policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (policy_version > 0), release_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runner_update_releases(id), channel TEXT NOT NULL, rollout_ring INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rollout_ring >= 0), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('requested','claim-issued','enrolled','probationary','active','draining-source','completed','failed','canceled')), failure_code TEXT, created_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_unix_ms >= 0), updated_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_unix_ms >= created_unix_ms), UNIQUE(pool_id,source_runner_id,generation), CHECK ((mode='autoscaled' AND target_fleet_request_id IS NOT NULL AND runner_slot_id IS NULL) OR (mode='fixed-host' AND runner_slot_id IS NOT NULL))) STRICT; CREATE INDEX runner_replacements_pool_state ON runner_replacements(pool_id,state,rollout_ring,generation); CREATE TABLE runner_software_update_claims (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), replacement_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES runner_replacements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, enrollment_token_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES enrollment_tokens(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, pool_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runner_pools(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('autoscaled','fixed-host')), source_runner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runners(id), source_posture_digest TEXT NOT NULL, runner_slot_id TEXT REFERENCES runner_slots(id), fleet_request_id TEXT REFERENCES runner_fleet_requests(id), provider TEXT, provider_instance_id TEXT, updater_identity_digest TEXT, runner_template_digest TEXT NOT NULL, identity_proof_digest TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0), artifact_digest TEXT NOT NULL, installed_digest TEXT NOT NULL, release_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runner_update_releases(id), component_profile_digest TEXT NOT NULL, update_root_digest TEXT NOT NULL, targets_metadata_digest TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_metadata_digest TEXT NOT NULL, timestamp_metadata_digest TEXT NOT NULL, policy_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (policy_version > 0), channel TEXT NOT NULL, rollout_ring INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rollout_ring >= 0), protocol_min INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (protocol_min > 0), protocol_max INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (protocol_max >= protocol_min), required_attestation_grade TEXT NOT NULL, attestation_nonce_digest TEXT NOT NULL, created_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_unix_ms >= 0), expires_unix_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expires_unix_ms > created_unix_ms AND expires_unix_ms <= created_unix_ms + 900000), canceled_unix_ms INTEGER, consumed_unix_ms INTEGER, runner_id TEXT REFERENCES runners(id), CHECK ((mode='autoscaled' AND fleet_request_id IS NOT NULL AND provider IS NOT NULL AND provider_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND runner_slot_id IS NULL AND updater_identity_digest IS NULL) OR (mode='fixed-host' AND runner_slot_id IS NOT NULL AND updater_identity_digest IS NOT NULL AND fleet_request_id IS NULL AND provider IS NULL AND provider_instance_id IS NULL))) STRICT; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runner_update_claim_slot_generation ON runner_software_update_claims(runner_slot_id,generation) WHERE runner_slot_id IS NOT NULL AND consumed_unix_ms IS NULL AND canceled_unix_ms IS NULL;
